title: STARKEEL
tagline: One thumb. Auto-fire. Link the fire.
summary: A one-thumb space shooter for phones. Your ship fires on its own: drag to dodge, link weapons into combos and take on 39 bosses across nine sectors.
description: Fly a lantern ship through nine hand-built sectors, one thumb at a time.

STARKEEL is a vertical space shooter made for phones. Your ship fires on its own. You drag anywhere on the screen to move, so your thumb never covers the ship, and you dodge orange bullets while your build grows. Strong builds can almost play themselves.

features.title: Easy to pick up
features.text: Drag anywhere to steer, firing is automatic. Only the small dot in the middle of your ship can be hit, and every enemy always moves and shoots the same way, so you learn a pattern once.

features.title: Crosslink combos
features.text: Each weapon leaves its own mark. Hit a marked enemy with a different weapon and the two combine into a combo. 14 weapons, 10 lenses and 15 pairings to discover.

features.title: Nine sectors, 39 bosses
features.text: Each sector has its own look, music, enemies and hazards, two mid-bosses and a sector boss with several acts. Pick a route and find the hidden bonus bosses.

features.title: The Workshop
features.text: Bring back scrap and cores to unlock hulls, pilots, parts and research between runs. Earn stars to open the next sectors.

features.title: Made to replay
features.text: A fresh layout every run, plus Endless, Gauntlet, Boss Rush, Daily Seed and Weekly Challenge modes, Heat mutators and 58 trophies.

features.title: Free to try
features.text: The tutorial and the first two sectors are free. One purchase unlocks the full game and your progress carries over. No ads, plays offline.

facts.label: Languages
facts.value: English, Português (Brasil), Español, Français, Italiano, Deutsch
